British (over 60) sprint champion 1971 and 1972 and double gold medallist in the over 60 sprints at both the Veteran Internationals at Crystal Palace and Cologne last year. ERNIE JARVIS (440y). Aged 67, retired publican, probably the fastest man "out of the holes" in the late 1920's.

We must sadly record the death of Ernie Jarvis, one time Club Champion over 100y, 220y and 440y. He was generally regarded as one of the fastest starters in the country during the late 1920s, and was a member of that famous Belgrave medley relay team some 40 years ago.
Odd memories come back - Bill Merryman, Tommy Scrimshaw, Ernie Jarvis, my special pal Jack Williams (we still keep in touch with his widow Mavis), Bill Sutton and many others.
